reuse.why: Uses the existing recurConfigToRSchedule, skipsWeekendOccurrences and getDateWithSkippedWeekend helpers rather than new weekend math, though it composes them itself.

duplication.why: The skip-daily / move-if-skipWeekend / passthrough dispatch is restated locally, mirroring the same three-way decision already written in getUpcomingDates and schedule-template, instead of being pulled into one shared function.

placement.why: New handler sits in server/schedules/app.ts next to schedule/get-upcoming-dates and is registered the same way.

scope.why: Only the new handler, its registration/type and tests.

maintainability.why: Short and readable; the per-occurrence dispatch is one more copy of the weekend decision to keep in sync when weekend rules change.

disguised_duplication.where: getDatesInRange in packages/loot-core/src/server/schedules/app.ts restates getUpcomingDates' weekend dispatch (skipsWeekendOccurrences ? drop weekend : skipWeekend ? getDateWithSkippedWeekend : date) as an if/else chain inside a loop.
